audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the level chart disagreed with the packet, and six of seven disagreed with the page's own whys. It gave Heimerdinger Level 1 (whys[0] says it is 'a wash'), gave Ornn Levels 2-5 (whys[1] to whys[3] describe your zone and 'every Ornn all-in suicidal'), and gave Heimerdinger Level 6 (whys[4] describes his chained double-knockup).
audit.why: Packet chart is [Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Ornn, Skill, Ornn] over a 49.36% even lane. The prose was written correctly; only the enum rows were inverted.
audit.corrected: All six wrong rows flipped in both layers as one group, ratings matched, and the phase whys for rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 5 rewritten to say what the row actually is.

audit.why: Four spikes, correctly ordered: your 4-5 nest peak, his Level 6 R, your first-item siege, his late tank-and-forge scaling. Front-loaded lane versus back-loaded champion is stated plainly in 'late'.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now admits first item is contested rather than claiming it as your spike, matching the packet's Skill row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Ornn cooldown appeared anywhere, and the content layer refers to his kit only as 'E dash', 'W Brittle' and 'R magma elemental'. breakdown.cooldowns summarised Volcanic Rupture as 'Wall-knockup setup' — which is backwards about which ability does the knocking up.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s) leaves a magma pillar; Searing Charge (14s at rank 1, 450 range) is the charge that knocks up when it collides with terrain — including that pillar. Bellows Breath (12s) is what applies Brittle. Call of the Forge God is 140s at rank 1. The pillar-plus-charge pairing is the actual kill setup and it was never spelled out.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now names all four with real numbers and states the pillar-into-charge sequence; dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d name Bellows Breath and Brittle; wants.foe[0] names Searing Charge, Volcanic Rupture and Bellows Breath instead of letter-slots.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E/R cooldowns, ranges and text

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Ornn contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One turret and no stun for you, but Searing Charge and Brittle are not online for him either — nobody owns level 1.

edits.before: Three turrets make your half of lane a no-entry zone. Only take the trade when Ornn's Volcanic Rupture is down.
edits.after: Second turret plus the slowing beams zone the lane — his only step-up is a 14s Searing Charge straight into them.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Volcanic Rupture's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your peak: the full nest plus the center-stun make every all-in suicidal — Brittle cannot out-DPS three turrets while he is stunned.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God plus its recast ram is a chained double-knockup — the one window that pins an immobile yordle.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Volcanic Rupture's cooldown.
edits.after: Liandry's keeps the siege honest, but he stacks tank stats faster than you stack pen — a coinflip.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. E-stun/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Volcanic Rupture: 9s — the pillar it leaves is what Searing Charge slams you into, so never stand between him and it. - Searing Charge: 14s at rank 1. - Call of the Forge God: 140s. - Your grenade: 11s flat.

edits.before: Ornn wastes Volcanic Rupture — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Bellows Breath applies Brittle on 12s — that is his damage setup.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Brittle from Bellows Breath is what turns his knockup into a kill.

edits.before: Liandry's into Rylai's keeps you owning the siege — beam burn and a slow tax on every Brittle setup he tries to walk into.
edits.after: Liandry's into Rylai's keeps the siege honest, but he buys tank stats faster than you buy penetration — it is a coinflip.

edits.before: Land E into a wall or his own Q pillar to knock you up, then proc Brittle with W for a true-damage chunk
edits.after: Land Searing Charge into a wall or his own Volcanic Rupture pillar, then shatter Brittle with Bellows Breath

notes: Worst chart in this slice: six of seven rows were inverted against both the packet and the page's own prose — a reader would have been told Ornn wins levels 2 through 5 and Heimerdinger wins level 6, which is backwards in both directions. Packet defect 'never names any of Ornn's abilities' is half right: the full layer names Volcanic Rupture throughout, but the content layer named nothing; Searing Charge, Bellows Breath and Call of the Forge God are now each named. Not asserted (kit is silent): how much true damage Brittle adds, whether it can be cleansed, and whether Searing Charge can collide with your turrets as terrain — that last one would change the whole matchup and I could not verify it.
